push.title: W 6-1 vs DragonsWarriors | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #12)
push.body:
Ten. Point. Zero. PhogsToffees, that's a Perfect Game #12 and I'd like it laminated, please.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 12th Perfect Game for us. Small wins add up to big ones.
+ 3 shots at DragonsWarriors's goal. You kept the pressure on like a lid on a pot.
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ Man of the Match, your 27th for us. You led by example, and the example was excellent.
+ You and BellyTb1 linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.

THE BAD
- 1 tackle won cost 0.1. Smarter choices fix it.
- Pass accuracy: 75%. 88%+ is the gold standard for a forward.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: You're not behind; you're just early to your comeback.

Rest up, legend. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 6-1 vs DragonsWarriors | You: 9.9 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 9.9 against DragonsWarriors. I'd hug you, but I'd probably cry on your jersey.

THE GOOD
+ 4 shots at DragonsWarriors's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 2 assists. Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ You and PhogsToffees combined like peanut butter and banana. Underrated and delicious.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 2. Put that in the team scrapbook.
+ That 9.9 is your 3rd best match performance of the season. Put it on the fridge.

THE BAD
- Tackles won 0, down from your usual 1. Homework: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
- Pass accuracy: 88%. Climb to 88%+ and you're top quarter.
- Shots on target: 75%. That's a B. The A-students among forwards are at 90%+.

Rep it: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

Keep doing you. You're doing great at it. - Coach Lasso
